eventMatrix.name: hover
evidence: Make preview hovered Basic Auth; computed color/background/shadow remained unchanged, cursor remained pointer
Make source has no Auth-specific onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave
eventMatrix.rationale: Make preview permits hover, but the Make Auth code does not express a distinct hover visual state.
eventMatrix.resolution: Vue keeps its existing hover affordance as a product interaction enhancement; it is not claimed as Make parity.

eventMatrix.name: focus
evidence: Make preview focused Basic username input; activeElement became the input and computed border/outline remained unchanged
AuthConfigSection uses native input without onFocus/onBlur
eventMatrix.rationale: Make preview permits focus, but the Make Auth code does not express a distinct focus visual state.
eventMatrix.resolution: Vue keeps the existing Element Plus focus affordance; no distinct Make visual state is claimed.

eventMatrix.name: blur
evidence: Make preview blurred Basic username input; activeElement left the input and computed border/outline remained unchanged
AuthConfigSection has no Auth-specific blur handler
eventMatrix.rationale: Blur is operable in Make but no distinct Auth blur behavior is expressed by the source.
eventMatrix.resolution: Vue retains the input value and normal component behavior; no Make-specific blur variant is claimed.

eventMatrix.name: active
evidence: setAuthType, setApiKeyLocation and password visibility click handlers in AuthConfigSection

eventMatrix.name: disabled
evidence: No disabled prop or branch in AuthConfigSection
eventMatrix.rationale: Make Auth design/code does not express a disabled state.
eventMatrix.resolution: No disabled visual state was invented as Make parity; Vue follows actual form availability.

eventMatrix.name: loading
eventMatrix.rationale: Make Auth code does not express a loading branch.
eventMatrix.resolution: Request-level loading remains outside Auth and is not attributed to Auth.

eventMatrix.name: success
evidence: No Auth success state in AuthConfigSection
eventMatrix.rationale: Make Auth code does not express an Auth-specific success state.
eventMatrix.resolution: No fake Auth success state was added.

eventMatrix.name: failure
evidence: No Auth failure state in AuthConfigSection
eventMatrix.rationale: Make Auth code does not express an Auth-specific validation/failure branch.
eventMatrix.resolution: No fake Auth failure state was added; real request errors remain in request response handling.

differences.current: Initial load showed Reconnecting, then authenticated iframe loaded after reload
differences.resolution: Retried with browser reload, logged in, and captured Auth interactions
differences.followUp: Use the saved preview screenshots as regression evidence
evidence: Make preview reload and login operation
differences.decisionBasis: Preview was reloaded and authenticated before interaction evidence was captured
differences.impact: Preview access was a setup issue and does not change Auth rendering

differences.current: Make Auth branch has no explicit handlers; preview confirms hover/focus/blur are operable without distinct visual variants; Vue provides CSS hover and Element Plus focus
differences.resolution: 已记录实际无变体行为，但当前未移除 Vue 的额外交互反馈，也没有用户明确接受该差异
differences.followUp: 确认产品是否要求 Vue 复刻 Make 的无变体行为；若要求，移除或限定 Auth 区域的额外 Hover/Focus 视觉反馈并重新进行浏览器验证
differences.decisionBasis: 准则要求用户明确接受才能标记 accepted-deviation；当前没有该决定，因此保留为 unresolved
differences.impact: Vue 在 Hover/Focus 上提供 Make 未表达的视觉反馈，无法报告为四方无差异

differences.current: Make inline style uses 0 1px 4px; Design uses 0 1px 2px
differences.decisionBasis: Visual authority is Design for static appearance
differences.impact: Segmented control shadow now matches Design

differences.followUp: Do not regress to Make demo spacing
differences.decisionBasis: Visual authority is Design for static spacing
differences.impact: No Auth empty state aligns with the Design vertical position

differences.current: Make and Vue now both use username 或 {{变量}}
differences.resolution: Vue placeholder changed to match Make exactly
differences.followUp: Keep the Make copy unless product supplies a replacement
differences.decisionBasis: 用户明确要求 Basic Auth 用户名占位文案对齐 Make；Make 源码和 Make 预览均显示 username 或 {{变量}}
differences.impact: Basic Auth 空输入框的引导文案与 Make 一致，避免误导用户填写固定账号

differences.source: Design measurements vs current Vue computed style
differences.current: Element Plus input flex layout initially compressed the 13px/14px auth icons below their Design sizes
differences.resolution: Added fixed flex-basis for prefix and eye icons; Vue now measures User/Key/Eye icons at 13x13 and Bearer/API Key eye icons at 14x14
differences.followUp: Keep the fixed icon basis when changing input suffix/prefix styles
differences.decisionBasis: Design defines the icon dimensions; browser computed style and bounding box now match those measurements
differences.impact: Basic/Digest 前置图标和各密码显隐图标不再被 Element Plus flex 布局压缩，静态尺寸与 Design 对齐
